user.title: Add P2000 Monitor
user.description: Set up the first sensor. Afterwards use 'Add sensor' to add as many sensors as you like, each with its own regions, services and filters.

data_description.all_services: Shows every P2000 alert in the Netherlands and ignores the region, service, priority and capcode filters. Text filters still apply.
data_description.capcodes: Separate multiple capcodes with a comma or semicolon. An alert matches if any of its capcodes matches.
data_description.include_text: Separate multiple terms with a comma or semicolon; an alert matches if it contains any of them.
data_description.exclude_text: Separate multiple terms with a comma or semicolon; an alert must contain none of them.
data_description.incident_window: How long follow-up alerts are grouped into the same incident.

abort.already_configured: P2000 Monitor is already added. Use 'Add sensor' for another sensor.
